mapper.select: SELECT pr.review_id, pr.order_id, pr.order_item_id, pr.user_id, pr.product_id, pr.rating, pr.content, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted_at, u.username, u.avatar_url, oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.image_url_snapshot FROM product_reviews pr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = pr.order_item_id WHERE pr.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.review_id, pr.order_id, pr.order_item_id, pr.user_id, pr.product_id, pr.rating, pr.content, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted_at, u.username, u.avatar_url, oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.image_url_snapshot FROM product_reviews pr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pr.user_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = pr.order_item_id WHERE pr.product_id = #{productId} AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
